messages:
maria: quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing/credits 1 — a couple of customer asks re: converting promo/dev credits to trial capacity. can we clarify?
jon: short answer: no self-serve today. conversions require sales signoff because of billing ledger implications.
priya: customer story: they want to apply unused dev credits toward a Dedicated trial for an upcoming pilot. manual process works but it's slow. can we propose a product flow?
dan: technical concerns: conversion needs atomicity so credits aren't double-spent. also need expiry rules.
billing-bot: current policy: promo/dev credits are non-transferable by default. manual conversion recorded as ledger adjustment when approved.
priya: proposal: self-serve conversion UI with limits: max 50% of unused dev credits, 30d validity after conversion, one-time per org. requires billing agreement acknowledgement.\on: legal check: add a checkbox in UI to accept quality and SLA differences when converting to trial capacity.
dan: infra note: lock the credit bucket during conversion transaction; emit audit log and webhook for accounting.
maria: leadership + ops: evaluate feasibility and compliance risk. if feasible, ship as "conversion pilot" to select customers.
jon: next steps: 1) product spec draft (owner @priya). 2) billing process sketch (owner @jon). 3) infra locking + audit spike (owner @dan). 4) legal signoff req (owner @maria).
maria: thanks all1 let's reconvene Friday 9am PT to review the spec.
